description: This file defines the CommentsController class responsible for handling HTTP requests related to comments in the application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments associated with articles identified by their slug.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: A controller class in ASP.NET Core MVC that manages comment-related HTTP endpoints, utilizing MediatR for command and query handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for a specified article.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by ID from an article.
